title: diporidium wallichii
intro: Diporidium wallichii, commonly known as Himalayan sweet root or Diplokele, is a plant species belonging to the family Aristolochiaceae. It is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal problems, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Diporidium wallichii include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and gastrointestinal soothing effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Diporidium wallichii include aristolochic acid, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
